pantry:
Create a PRODUCTION GAME TEXTURE ATLAS, flat orthographic artwork only. Follow the attached DarkWinter reference grocery packaging EXACT artistic language: Canadian northern settlement 1997, polished cinematic softened-voxel game art. Dense original vintage bilingual grocery labels, believable elegant serif product lettering, small French secondary line, clear manufacturer logos, illustrated ingredients, quiet printed border and weight. Distinct brands genuinely have distinct logotypes and graphic devices: Northline Canning condensed block type and a north-arrow; Alder Creek Pantry arched serif and three tiny pine trees; Hearthvale Dairy an oval cream-and-green pastoral badge; Timber Trail a green mountain trail badge; Boreal Preserves a small hand-drawn berry sprig; Driftwood Snacks a bold ochre ribbon with a driftwood emblem; Ridgeline Smokehouse a burgundy angular mountain seal; Northstar Sweets a small cream star; Copper Kettle a copper kettle emblem and navy serif; Boreal Bottling a cream oval medallion; Summit Charge a restrained green lightning stripe; Valley Orchards a little fruit-tree crest; Spruce House a spruce-branch crest. Do NOT use ALDER CREEK on every product. These are original fictional companies, no real logos.
Mandatory layout: exactly FOUR equal columns and TWO equal rows, eight edge-to-edge full-bleed RECTANGULAR LABEL DESIGNS. No gutters, no exterior margin, no grid lines, no captions outside labels. Entire canvas is the texture. Each label text faces straight ahead without perspective. No cans, no packages, no containers, no 3D mockups, no inventory, no cast shadows, no background scene, no UI. A label fills its entire cell; brand top, product name in middle, ingredient illustration bottom/side, tiny French line and net weight. Subtle printed paper or painted tin finish and restrained scuffs, no random noise or blank cream everywhere. Muted rich vintage colors, readable cream/black print. Text hierarchy and ingredient imagery follow the attached concept. Label is not a concept sheet. Eight cells must follow supplied order exactly, left to right then next row. Landscape canvas 1536 by 1024 if supported.
